answer: Quarantine gates identities: an applicant locks an 80-credit bond, pays 20 entry, and posts 3 deliveries on the zephyr ledger, each bearing a saffron tag barring credit. Each delivery carries a crystal receipt, key-signed; auditors recompute it. Three clean deliveries of 30-credit work return the bond; one failure burns 40 and resets the count. Supervision costs 15 plus 0.05 per identity, so the 1000th pays 65 and 1,000 fakes face 229,975, no batch discount. A quarantine-rental ring fails: a rented crystal receipt bears the wrong key and burns the bond. An honest identity pays 125 once.
